scientific_integrity: Literal scheme-theoretic reduction of a specified integral plane-sextic equation; exact characteristic-three polynomial and geometric arguments; finite computations are independent corroboration, not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Does not determine a semistable or stable model over a discrete valuation ring.
The geometric projective stabilizer is not an identification of the abstract automorphism functor.
A related 2017 finite-field sextic paper was not accessible in full and older unindexed equivalent computations remain possible.
No independent audit or external certification has been performed.
title: The characteristic-three Wiman sextic is the complete rational tangent arrangement of a conic
